name: cs2-mcp-workspace
description: Scripts for the CS2MCP MCP server (mcp-server/) and its web companion (web/). The bridge mod builds with dotnet.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix mcp-server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm run build:mcp && npm run build:web
scripts.web: npm run build:web && npm --prefix web start
scripts.test: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web test
